controls.label: Shape
controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius, lit by K2-26; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured color.
controls.notes: No image or color of K2-26 b is published: the sphere has its measured size, and the gray marks an unresolved surface. The lighting is its own star's, at the measured orbit. The gray takes the color of k2-26's light, as its color dataset measures it.

charts.alt: The orbits of K2-26's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-26 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

K2-26 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (45, 71, 72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 83181153, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 19-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
